result.summary: The home screen of the food delivery app is mostly well-formed. The header, search, chips, promo banner, carousel and list cards all render correctly. Only a few minor visual issues stand out, and nothing is clearly broken.

issues.description: The time badges (e.g. '15–25 min') on the 'Fastest near you' cards overlap the bottom-left corner of the dish illustration and sit very close to the card edge. On the first card the badge partly covers the plate and looks cramped.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent padding and position the badges so they don't overlap the key part of the image, or move them fully inside the image area.

issues.description: The grey secondary text (delivery fee, '25–35 min', '(500+)') and the search placeholder are light on a light background, so contrast is low. The white text on the lighter green area of the promo banner is also somewhat weak.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and placeholder colors to meet WCAG 4.5:1 contrast, and deepen the banner green behind the white text.

issues.description: The decorative circles in the promo banner have a hard, uneven edge at the bottom right where they get clipped. This looks slightly glitchy. The favorite heart buttons on the image cards also have low-contrast dark translucent backgrounds against dark photos.
issues.suggestion: Clean up the banner decoration so the clipping looks intentional, and give the heart buttons a more visible background or a light fill.
